generator.title: QR Generator
generator.subtitle: Turn a link into a QR Code. Free, pick your own colors, with a logo in the center.
generator.subtitlePaid: For one QR code. Set the link, colors, and logo, then continue to payment.
generator.subtitleAdmin: Set the link, colors, and logo, then save. QR codes made by admins use Premium features at no cost.
generator.linkInside: This contains a link plus other words. When scanned, it shows as plain text and the link won't open directly.
generator.tooLong: The text is too long for a QR Code. Shorten your link.
generator.logoShown: The logo shows in the center of the QR.
generator.logoHidden: The QR shows without a logo.
generator.logoSwitch: Show the logo in the center of the QR
generator.sameColor: The QR color and background color are the same, so the QR can't be scanned. Pick two different colors.
generator.transparentNote: Transparent background: PNG and SVG download without a background. Place the QR on a plain surface whose color is very different from the QR color so it stays easy to scan.
generator.lowContrast: Low color contrast ({{ratio}}:1). The QR may be hard to scan. Pick a darker color for the QR and a lighter one for the background.
generator.upsell: Want a QR without the logo, with colors and a link you can change anytime? Monthly plan Rp30.000 or Yearly Rp300.000 for one QR.
generator.orderNote: When transferring, a unique code from 1 to 99 is added to the amount so it's easy to match. The license activates once payment is complete.
generator.previewEmpty: Enter a link to see the QR Code
generator.saveHint: Save to your account before downloading so the QR can be deactivated later.
generator.loginToSave: Log in to save the QR to your account
generator.downloadNote: PNG 1024 px for print and social media. SVG can be scaled up without losing quality.

toast.pngFailed: The QR couldn't be downloaded as PNG.
